verdict.rationale: Customer.io's official MCP server and CLI let an agent create and manage automations and one-time sends, work with segments, and draft messages (docs-27, docs-26, docs-1, docs-16), and broadcasts can be queued to a specified recipient list for a set time (docs-13). However, nothing documents leaving an agent-built campaign in a draft or pending state for a human to approve before it sends. The MCP read/write permission split (docs-10) controls which tool actions the agent may take, not whether a send is approved. Missing for 10: a documented draft/pending-approval state for agent-created campaigns, an explicit human sign-off step before send, and hands-on corroboration of an agent scheduling a segment-targeted send.
